page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Flex.45-180 is an Arm-based compute instance built on the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor family. The server provides 90 dedicated physical cores executing the arm64 instruction set at a base frequency of 3.6 GHz. Because each physical core corresponds to a single execution thread, the processor avoids the resource contention and execution jitter typical of simultaneous multithreading designs. System memory totals 180 GB, providing an exact allocation ratio of 2 GB RAM per dedicated core.

This server instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring all operating system and persistent file systems to run through remote block storage volumes. Graphics processing units and hardware accelerators are absent from the configuration, focusing physical resources entirely on general CPU compute. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address for external host reachability.

The 2 GB per core profile establishes the server as a high-density compute offering rather than a memory-heavy environment. Cost efficiency is driven by the density of dedicated Ampere physical cores, offering predictable throughput for highly parallel tasks without hyperthreading overhead. Organizations must evaluate application compatibility with arm64 architectures prior to deployment. Best-fit workloads include distributed build clusters, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, containerized microservices, scientific batch processing, and horizontally scalable web serving.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Flex.45-180 is a compute-oriented instance powered by Ampere AmpereOne-M processors on the arm64 architecture. The configuration supplies 90 dedicated physical cores clocked at 3.6 GHz with a single thread per core, preventing thread contention common in virtualized multi-tenant environments. Paired with 180 GB of system memory, the machine maintains a 2 GB per core allocation ratio. The instance includes no integrated local storage or graphics accelerators, necessitating external block volumes for persistent disk storage. One complimentary public IPv4 address is bundled with the instance. The high physical core count and dedicated execution pipelines make VM.Standard.A4.Flex.45-180 effective for parallel compute tasks, container clusters, continuous integration builds, and CPU-intensive applications compiled for 64-bit Arm systems.
